Plot inductance vs turns for a given PVC coil form

Source: R/loadedDipole.R
plot_coil_turns.Rd

Plot inductance vs turns for a given PVC coil form

Usage

plot_coil_turns(
  pvc_size = "1-1/2",
  wire_diameter = 0.064,
  turn_spacing = NULL,
  N_range = 5:150
)

Arguments

pvc_size

PVC nominal size.

wire_diameter

Wire diameter in inches.

turn_spacing

Turn spacing in inches.

N_range

Range of turns to evaluate.
